{{Quote|You're, what? Eighteen? Nineteen?''"<br />"''Eighteen.''"<br />"''I have a granddaughter that age. I wouldn't want her alone with Bollis, either.|General Deerian and Emperor's Hand Mara Jade|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''granddaughter''' of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Deerian]]. She was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="Allegiance" /> in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="AllegianceD" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="AllegianceD" /> Deerian attended a [[Glovstoak's party|party]] hosted by Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Glovstoak]] in his [[Glovstoak's palace|palace]], where he met the eighteen-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. At the party, the general separated Jade from Glovstoak's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Mink Bollis]], who had invited the Emperor's Hand to be alone with him as Deerian did not want her alone with Bollis. The general then told the Emperor's Hand that he would not want his granddaughter, who also was eighteen, alone with Glovstoak's aide either.<ref name="Allegiance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deerian's granddaughter was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']], which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Allegiance" />
